_comment: One catalogue for the whole product: the WebView2 workbench, the native dialogs,
and the exported HTML report all read these keys. Keeping them in one file means a
translated string cannot exist in the UI but not in the report a colleague opens.
English is the fallback for every key. A missing Turkish string renders the English
one rather than the raw key: a half-translated sentence is readable, an identifier
Placeholders are {0}, {1}, ... and are positional in both languages, because Turkish
word order routinely differs from English and a named-order assumption would break.

en.app.title: CaYaTrace
en.elevation.banner_body: Kernel tracing is unavailable, so file, registry, process, and network events will not be recorded. Only before/after system snapshots will be collected.
en.capture.title: Record a session
en.capture.subtitle: Watch what a program does to this machine, from the first process it starts to the last request it sends.
en.capture.mode.launch_hint: CaYaTrace starts it and follows every process it creates.
en.capture.mode.attach_hint: Follows a process that is already running, and its children.
en.capture.mode.system_hint: Records everything, and lets you decide the subject afterwards.
en.capture.name: Session name
en.capture.name_placeholder: leave empty to name it after the program
en.capture.duration_hint: 0 means record until you press stop.
en.capture.opt.snapshots_hint: Catches changes made by things ETW cannot attribute, at the cost of a slower start and stop.
en.capture.opt.reads_hint: Far higher volume. Useful when you need to know what a program looked at, not just what it changed.
en.capture.opt.scoped: Discard activity outside the target's process tree
en.capture.opt.scoped_hint: Much smaller sessions. The trade is that scope cannot be widened afterwards.
en.capture.opt.packets_hint: Uses the packet monitor built into Windows and writes a pcapng you can open in Wireshark. Needs administrator rights.
en.capture.opt.intercept_hint: Makes request and response bodies readable by installing a temporary certificate authority into this machine's trusted roots. You will be asked to confirm, and it is removed when the session ends. Use a disposable VM.
en.capture.stopping: Stopping — resolving names and taking the after snapshot…
en.capture.live_hint: Run the program the way a user would. Everything it touches is being recorded.
en.capture.needs_target: Choose a program to launch first.
en.capture.needs_pid: Enter the process id to attach to.
en.sessions.title: Recorded sessions
en.sessions.subtitle: Everything recorded under the session folder, newest first.
en.sessions.empty: No sessions here yet. Record one from the Capture tab.
en.overview.title: Overview
en.overview.headline_none: No persistent changes were attributed to the subject.
en.overview.headline_one: 1 notable change was attributed to the subject.
en.overview.headline_many: {0} notable changes were attributed to the subject.
en.overview.no_network: No network activity was attributed to the subject.
en.quality.clean_body: No events were lost and every artifact resolved to a name.
en.quality.degraded_title: This session is incomplete — findings below are a floor, not a ceiling
en.quality.events_lost: {0} events lost to ETW buffer pressure
en.findings.title: Findings
en.findings.filter_placeholder: Filter by path, key, host, or command line…
en.findings.empty: No notable changes were attributed to the subject.
en.findings.unattributed: this change could not be attributed to a process
en.findings.snapshot_only: found by comparing system state before and after; no process could be attributed
en.tree.title: Causal tree
en.tree.select_prompt: Select a node to inspect the evidence behind it.
en.network.title: Network
en.network.subtitle: Where the subject connected, what it asked for, and how much moved.
en.network.encrypted: encrypted — enable HTTPS interception to read the body
en.network.no_urls: Connections were recorded but no URLs. CaYaTrace reads URLs from the Windows HTTP stacks (WinINet and WinHTTP); a program that brings its own TLS — most .NET, Go, and Chromium software — is invisible to them. Record again with HTTPS interception to see the URLs and bodies.
en.network.unattributed_note: {0} connection(s) could not be tied to a process and are not listed here. Export with "Everything" to see them.
en.network.truncated_note: This table was capped. Export with "Everything" for the complete list.
en.compare.title: Compare machines
en.compare.subtitle: Run the same program on two or more machines and the parts that recur are its real behaviour. The parts that do not are noise — a random directory, a per-install GUID, a timestamped log.
en.compare.stable_hint: These recur everywhere, so they are what the program does rather than what happened to change.
en.compare.template_hint: Segments that differed between machines are shown as {*}. A removal package built from this matches a third machine that spells them differently again.
en.compare.export_package: Export removal package from the shared set
en.assistant.title: Assistant
en.assistant.subtitle: Findings, scores, and the reasons behind them are CaYaTrace's own rules and need no model. A local model only adds a label per finding — and it is measured against known answers before any of it is shown.
en.assistant.status_down_hint: Start it with `ollama serve`, or point CaYaTrace at another address.
en.assistant.probe_hint: Asks each model to classify Windows artifacts whose correct answer is not in dispute, then scores schema compliance, correctness, and whether it stayed grounded in the evidence it was given.
en.assistant.none_suitable: None of the installed models scored well enough to add anything. Findings are still produced from CaYaTrace's built-in rules. For labelling, an 8B instruct model is usually the smallest that helps; coder-tuned and sub-1B models score poorly at this.
en.assistant.model_used: Scores and reasons above are CaYaTrace's own; the model contributed only the labels.
en.assistant.no_model_used: All findings above are rule-based. No model was involved.
en.assistant.disagreement: The model's label disagrees with the rules
en.assistant.label: Model label
en.assistant.vt_hint: Looks up dropped executables at VirusTotal by hash. CaYaTrace never uploads a file — submitting a sample publishes it permanently. A lookup still tells the service that someone is interested in this exact file.
en.assistant.vt_key_hint: Read from CAYATRACE_VT_API_KEY when set. A key typed here is held in memory for this run only and never written to disk.
en.assistant.vt_missing_key: No API key. Set CAYATRACE_VT_API_KEY, or type one above.
en.remediate.title: Remediation
en.remediate.subtitle: Everything the subject added, as a plan you can review, carry to another machine, and undo.
en.remediate.empty: No persistent changes were attributed to the subject. Either it genuinely changed nothing, or the session was recorded without kernel tracing.
en.remediate.export_hint: A .ctpkg you can carry to a machine that has never run CaYaTrace. It re-verifies every item against that machine before touching anything.
en.remediate.apply: Remove selected items on this machine
en.remediate.opt.modified: Files the subject modified but did not create
en.remediate.opt.modified_hint: Off by default. Removing a file that existed before the subject ran takes away something that was not its to take.
en.remediate.opt.out_of_scope: Changes not attributed to the subject's process tree
en.fleet.title: Fleet
en.fleet.subtitle: Record on several machines at once. An agent stays inert until you approve it here, and everything between them is encrypted with a key derived from the pairing code — not from the network's TLS, which a lab network rarely has working.
en.fleet.pairing_hint: Type this into the agent. It is the whole of the authentication, so treat it like a password and issue a new one for each run.
en.fleet.agent_command: Run this on the machine you want to record:
en.fleet.waiting: Waiting for an agent to connect.
en.fleet.pending_title: An agent is asking to join
en.fleet.approve_hint: Nothing is collected from this machine until you approve it.
en.fleet.fingerprint_hint: Shown on both machines. If they differ, you are not talking to the machine you think you are.
en.fleet.no_remote_invasive: Packet capture and HTTPS interception are never started remotely. Both change the machine they run on, and a host that could trigger them turns a paired agent into a remote administration channel.
en.export.title: Export
en.export.subtitle: Write this session out for someone else to read, or for another tool to consume.
en.export.format.html_hint: One self-contained file. Opens in any browser with no tool, no server, and no network — this same view, with the data baked in.
en.export.format.json_hint: The causal tree and session metadata, for scripting.
en.export.format.csv_hint: One row per observation. Opens in a spreadsheet.
en.export.format.tree_hint: Plain text, diffable, pasteable into a ticket.
en.export.format.package_hint: A .ctpkg to carry to another machine.
en.export.scope.minimal_hint: The notable changes and the reasons behind them. Smallest, and the right choice for a reader who will not go through a tree.
en.export.scope.standard_hint: Findings, the causal tree, and network activity.
en.export.scope.full_hint: Every recorded observation, including reads and out-of-scope activity.
en.export.categories_hint: Leave all selected to include everything.
en.error.title: Something went wrong
en.error.not_a_session: {0} does not contain a CaYaTrace session.
en.error.webview_missing: The WebView2 runtime could not be started. Install it from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/ or use the command line instead.
en.error.capture_failed: The session could not be started.
en.report.footer: Recorded with CaYaTrace {0} on {1}. Findings are rule-based and reproducible from the data in this file.
en.report.disclaimer: This report can contain credentials, tokens, cookies, and personal data captured from the machine it was recorded on. Treat it as sensitive.
en.persistence.title: Persistence
en.persistence.subtitle: Every way the subject arranged to run again without being asked, with what it configured.
en.persistence.none_hint: Nothing in this session installed a service, registered a task, or wrote to a startup location.
en.timeline.title: Timeline
en.timeline.subtitle: What ran, in order, for how long, and what each one touched. Windows will not say which process closed another without a kernel driver, so an ending is shown with its exit status rather than a culprit.
en.timeline.filter_placeholder: Filter by name, path or command line…
en.timeline.none_hint: No process started while this was recording. Tick the box above to see what was already running.
en.chat.title: Ask about this session
en.chat.hint: Answers are computed from the session itself. A local model, if one is configured, only rewords them — it is never asked to find anything and cannot add a fact.
en.chat.placeholder: Is anything adding itself to startup, and where?
en.chat.empty: Ask a question, or pick one below.
en.chat.q.persistence: Is anything adding itself to startup, and where?
en.chat.q.tasks: What scheduled tasks did it register?
en.chat.q.network: Which hosts did it connect to?
en.remediate.package_hint: A package built on another machine carries measured patterns, not literal paths. What it resolves to here is shown for review before anything is applied.
en.remediate.package_damaged: {0} is damaged — its contents do not match its hash
en.remediate.blocked: What could not be dealt with
en.quarantine.title: In quarantine
en.quarantine.hint: Nothing was deleted. These were moved here and can be put back, left, or deleted for good — deleting is the one step that cannot be undone.
en.quarantine.occupied: something is at the original location now
en.quarantine.confirm_restore_body: Each file returns to where it came from. Anything whose original location is now occupied is left alone.
en.quarantine.confirm_delete_body: This cannot be undone. Nothing outside the quarantine folder will be touched.
en.fleet.agent_hint: This machine connects out to a host you name and then does nothing until that host approves it. No port is opened here.
en.fleet.agent_check_fingerprint: Check that the host shows the same fingerprint before it approves this machine.
en.fleet.agent.needs_host: Enter a host address and a pairing code.
en.fleet.agent.handshake_failed: The handshake failed. A wrong pairing code and a wrong address look identical here.
en.fleet.check_fingerprint: Approve only if this fingerprint matches the one shown on that machine.
en.fleet.confirm_stop_title: Stop this on the remote machine?
en.fleet.confirm_stop_body: The agent checks the target against its own machine before acting, and refuses anything the kernel marks critical.
en.fleet.control.unknown: That request is not something an agent will act on.
en.network.scope.LocalNetwork_hint: Another machine on the same network. This is how software coordinates with its own components, and it appears in no firewall log and no proxy.
en.network.scope.Loopback_hint: One process on this machine talking to another. A temporary local server a program opens for its own components shows up here.
en.network.body_binary: Not text, so it is shown as bytes.
en.network.body_truncated: Only the beginning was kept. The start of a conversation is where the protocol, the request and the credentials are; the rest is usually payload.
en.network.body_unknown: That content is not in this session.
en.timeline.include_existing: Also show what was already running
en.network.loopback_not_captured: Conversations between two processes on this machine are listed under Connections but their contents are not captured here: the Windows packet monitor observes network adapters, and traffic that never leaves the machine does not cross one. Use the intercepting proxy for local HTTP.
en.chat.no_models_found: None found at that endpoint. Answers still work without one.
en.chat.stopped: stopped before the model answered — this is the measured answer
en.remediate.no_session: No session is loaded, so a plan cannot be built from a recording. Opening a package still works — that is what packages are for.
en.network.body_not_exported: Contents were not carried into this report. Export at full depth to include them.
en.network.peer_unknown: on this machine, other end not identified
en.network.loopback_no_contents: Recorded through Winsock, which is the only thing that sees traffic between two processes on this machine. It reports who talked to whom and how much, but not what was said: the bytes are only ever a pointer into the sending program.
en.chat.q.local: Did programs on this machine talk to each other?
en.chat.q.rank: Which of those is most critical?
en.chat.web: Look things up on the web
en.chat.web_note: Off by default. Searching for a name publishes it.
en.chat.web_caption: From a web search — somebody's claim, not measured on this machine
en.chat.needs_admin: Run these from an elevated prompt.
en.proxy.sweep.wininet_restored: Put the system proxy back the way an interrupted CaYaTrace session found it.
en.proxy.sweep.winhttp_restored: Put the machine-wide WinHTTP proxy back the way an interrupted CaYaTrace session found it.
en.proxy.sweep.winhttp_needs_admin: An interrupted CaYaTrace session left the machine-wide WinHTTP proxy pointing at a port that is no longer listening. Services, installers and updaters will fail to reach the network until it is put back, and doing that needs administrator rights. Run CaYaTrace as administrator, or from an elevated prompt run:  netsh winhttp reset proxy
en.proxy.sweep.ca_removed: Removed a temporary certificate authority left in this machine's trusted roots by an interrupted CaYaTrace session.
en.proxy.sweep.ca_needs_admin: A temporary CaYaTrace certificate authority is still trusted by this machine and could not be removed without administrator rights. While it is trusted, anything running as you can impersonate any website. It expires on its own within 12 hours of being created; to clear it now, run CaYaTrace as administrator.

tr.report.disclaimer: Bu rapor, kaydedildiği makineden alınmış kimlik bilgileri, jetonlar, çerezler ve kişisel veriler içerebilir. Hassas bir belge gibi davranın.
tr.persistence.title: Kalıcılık
tr.persistence.subtitle: İzlenen programın tekrar çalışmak için kurduğu her yol ve neyi nasıl ayarladığı.
tr.persistence.none: Yeniden başlatmadan sonra hiçbir şey kalmıyor
tr.persistence.none_hint: Bu oturumda hiçbir şey servis kurmadı, görev kaydetmedi veya bir başlangıç konumuna yazmadı.
tr.timeline.title: Zaman çizelgesi
tr.timeline.subtitle: Ne çalıştı, hangi sırayla, ne kadar süreyle ve her biri neye dokundu. Windows, çekirdek sürücüsü olmadan bir sürecin hangi süreci kapattığını bildirmez; bu yüzden sonlanma, bir suçlu yerine çıkış durumuyla gösterilir.
tr.timeline.filter_placeholder: Ada, yola veya komut satırına göre süz…
tr.timeline.none: Bu oturum sırasında hiçbir şey başlamadı
tr.timeline.none_hint: Kayıt sırasında hiçbir süreç başlamadı. Zaten çalışmakta olanları görmek için yukarıdaki kutuyu işaretleyin.
tr.chat.title: Bu oturum hakkında sor
tr.chat.hint: Yanıtlar doğrudan oturumun kendisinden hesaplanır. Yerel bir model tanımlıysa yalnızca ifadeyi yeniden yazar; hiçbir şeyi bulması istenmez ve bir bilgi ekleyemez.
tr.chat.placeholder: Kendini başlangıca ekleyen bir şey var mı, yolu ne?
tr.chat.empty: Bir soru sorun ya da aşağıdan birini seçin.
tr.chat.q.persistence: Kendini başlangıca ekleyen bir şey var mı, yolu ne?
tr.remediate.package_hint: Başka bir makinede oluşturulan paket, birebir yollar değil ölçülmüş kalıplar taşır. Burada neye karşılık geldiği, hiçbir şey uygulanmadan önce incelemeye sunulur.
tr.quarantine.title: Karantinada
tr.quarantine.hint: Hiçbir şey silinmedi. Bunlar buraya taşındı; geri konabilir, bırakılabilir veya kalıcı olarak silinebilir — silme, geri alınamayan tek adımdır.
tr.quarantine.occupied: özgün konumda şu an başka bir şey var
tr.quarantine.confirm_restore_body: Her dosya geldiği yere döner. Özgün konumu artık dolu olanlara dokunulmaz.
tr.quarantine.confirm_delete_body: Bu geri alınamaz. Karantina klasörünün dışındaki hiçbir şeye dokunulmaz.
tr.fleet.agent_hint: Bu makine, adını verdiğiniz bir ana makineye kendisi bağlanır ve o makine onaylayana kadar hiçbir şey yapmaz. Burada hiçbir port açılmaz.
tr.fleet.agent_check_fingerprint: Ana makinenin bu makineyi onaylamadan önce aynı parmak izini gösterdiğini doğrulayın.
tr.fleet.agent.needs_host: Bir ana makine adresi ve eşleştirme kodu girin.
tr.fleet.agent.handshake_failed: El sıkışma başarısız. Yanlış eşleştirme kodu ile yanlış adres burada aynı görünür.
tr.fleet.check_fingerprint: Yalnızca bu parmak izi o makinede görünenle aynıysa onaylayın.
tr.fleet.confirm_stop_body: Ajan, işlem yapmadan önce hedefi kendi makinesinde doğrular ve çekirdeğin kritik işaretlediği hiçbir şeye dokunmaz.
tr.fleet.control.unknown: Bu istek, bir ajanın uygulayacağı türden değil.
tr.network.scope.LocalNetwork_hint: Aynı ağdaki başka bir makine. Yazılımın kendi bileşenleriyle haberleşme biçimi budur ve hiçbir güvenlik duvarı günlüğünde ya da vekil sunucuda görünmez.
tr.network.scope.Loopback_hint: Bu makinedeki bir sürecin bir diğeriyle konuşması. Bir programın kendi bileşenleri için açtığı geçici yerel sunucu burada görünür.
tr.network.body_binary: Metin olmadığı için baytlar hâlinde gösteriliyor.
tr.network.body_truncated: Yalnızca başı saklandı. Bir konuşmanın başı; protokolün, isteğin ve kimlik bilgilerinin bulunduğu yerdir, gerisi genellikle veridir.
tr.network.loopback_not_captured: Bu makinedeki iki süreç arasındaki konuşmalar Bağlantılar altında listelenir, ancak içerikleri burada yakalanmaz: Windows paket izleyicisi ağ bağdaştırıcılarını gözlemler ve makineden hiç çıkmayan trafik bir bağdaştırıcıdan geçmez. Yerel HTTP için araya giren vekil sunucuyu kullanın.
tr.chat.no_models_found: Bu uç noktada model bulunamadı. Yanıtlar model olmadan da çalışır.
tr.chat.stopped: model yanıtlamadan durduruldu — bu, ölçülen yanıt
tr.remediate.no_session: Yüklü oturum yok, bu yüzden bir kayıttan plan oluşturulamaz. Paket açmak yine de çalışır; paketler zaten bunun içindir.
tr.network.body_not_exported: İçerik bu rapora taşınmadı. Dahil etmek için tam derinlikte dışa aktarın.
tr.network.loopback_no_contents: Winsock üzerinden kaydedildi; bu makinedeki iki süreç arasındaki trafiği gören tek kaynak odur. Kimin kiminle ve ne kadar konuştuğunu bildirir, ne konuşulduğunu değil: baytlar yalnızca gönderen programın belleğine bir işaretçi olarak geçer.
tr.chat.q.local: Bu makinedeki programlar birbiriyle haberleşti mi?
tr.chat.web_note: Varsayılan olarak kapalı. Bir adı aratmak onu dışarıya bildirir.
tr.chat.web_caption: Web aramasından — bu makinede ölçülmedi, birinin iddiası
tr.chat.needs_admin: Bunları yönetici yetkisiyle açılmış bir istemde çalıştırın.
tr.proxy.sweep.wininet_restored: Yarıda kalan bir CaYaTrace oturumunun değiştirdiği sistem ara sunucu ayarı eski haline getirildi.
tr.proxy.sweep.winhttp_restored: Yarıda kalan bir CaYaTrace oturumunun değiştirdiği makine genelindeki WinHTTP ara sunucu ayarı eski haline getirildi.
tr.proxy.sweep.winhttp_needs_admin: Yarıda kalan bir CaYaTrace oturumu, makine genelindeki WinHTTP ara sunucusunu artık dinlenmeyen bir bağlantı noktasına yönlendirilmiş bırakmış. Bu geri alınana kadar hizmetler, kurulum programları ve güncelleyiciler ağa erişemez; geri almak da yönetici yetkisi ister. CaYaTrace'i yönetici olarak çalıştırın veya yükseltilmiş bir komut isteminde şunu çalıştırın:  netsh winhttp reset proxy
tr.proxy.sweep.ca_removed: Yarıda kalan bir CaYaTrace oturumunun bu makinenin güvenilir köklerinde bıraktığı geçici sertifika yetkilisi kaldırıldı.
tr.proxy.sweep.ca_needs_admin: Geçici bir CaYaTrace sertifika yetkilisi bu makine tarafından hâlâ güveniliyor ve yönetici yetkisi olmadan kaldırılamadı. Güvenildiği sürece sizin yetkinizle çalışan herhangi bir program kendini herhangi bir web sitesi gibi gösterebilir. Oluşturulmasından itibaren 12 saat içinde kendiliğinden geçersiz olur; şimdi temizlemek için CaYaTrace'i yönetici olarak çalıştırın.
